author: BoBo Art
cover_prompt: Full-color vibrant illustration of a cozy rainy day scene. SQUARE format (1:1 aspect ratio). A charming cottage window viewed from inside, with heavy rain streaming down the glass panes. On the wide windowsill, a steaming cup of tea with a saucer, a stack of old books, and a lit candle in a glass jar. A chunky knitted blanket drapes over a plush armchair beside the window. A kawaii cat with big sparkly eyes curls up on the blanket. Outside the rain-streaked window, a lush garden with hydrangea bushes and a stone path glistens in the rain. Soft warm amber lighting inside contrasts with cool blue-gray tones outside. Cozy cottagecore aesthetic, warm premium feel. Text reads "Rainy Day Cozy Scenes" and "Coloring Book for Adults" in elegant hand-lettered style.
